name: Cookies Addons Views
description: COOKiES add-on that withholds a Views display (chosen by view ID and display ID) behind cookie consent, showing a placeholder overlay and AJAX-loading the view once the matching cookies service is accepted.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Blocks a Views display (identified by view ID and display ID) until the visitor consents to a configured COOKiES service, then loads the view via AJAX. Reads the cookiesjsr cookie server-side to decide gating and has built-in handling for Leaflet map views. Configure at /admin/config/system/cookies-addons-views.
